page.title: Storage connections
page.subtitle: Where your company's document files are kept.

actions.testCooling: Test limit reached, wait a minute

fieldHints.endpoint: Optional. Must be an https URL.
fieldHints.directory: Letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores only.
fieldHints.credentials_expires_at: Optional. You'll be warned 30 days before.

form.createDescription: Saving only checks the format. Test the connection afterwards to make it usable.
form.editDescription: Change the name or where it points. Secrets have their own action.
form.credentialsHint: Secrets are stored securely and are never shown again.
form.localHint: A server folder has no credentials. The server decides where it really lives.
form.providerLocked: The provider can't be changed. Create a new connection instead.
form.movesWarning: Changing where it points sends the connection back to Pending until it passes a new test.
form.movesDefaultWarning: This is the default connection. Changing where it points sends it back to Pending and it stops being the default until it passes a new test.

errors.directory: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores only.
errors.controlChars: The name can't contain control characters.

credentials.title: Replace credentials
credentials.description: Enter the full new set of credentials for “{{name}}”.
credentials.warning: The connection goes back to Pending and must pass a new test before it can receive files.
credentials.warningDefault: This is the default connection. It goes back to Pending and stops being the default until it passes a new test.
credentials.expiryReplaced: The expiry date is replaced too: leave it empty and it is cleared.

test.title: Connection test
test.description: Writes a small probe file to “{{name}}”, reads it back, compares and deletes it.
test.nextPassed: The connection is now active. You can make it the default.
test.nextFailed: Fix the cause, then test again. Until it passes, it can't receive files.
test.rateLimited: Too many tests. You can test 5 times a minute; try again shortly.
test.failed: The test could not be run.

default.title: Make this the default?
default.description: New files will be stored in “{{name}}”. The current default is replaced.

disable.title: Disable this connection?
disable.description: “{{name}}” will stop receiving new files. Existing files stay readable. This cannot be undone: a disabled connection can't be enabled again, you'd create a new one.
disable.defaultWarning: It is the default: until another active connection is made the default, uploads will fail.

delete.title: Delete this connection?
delete.description: “{{name}}” will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

notice.created: Connection created. Test it before it can receive files.
notice.updated: Connection updated. Test it again if you changed where it points.
notice.credentialsReplaced: Credentials replaced. Test the connection before it can receive files.
notice.disable: Connection disabled. Existing files stay readable.
notice.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
notice.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

states.emptyCreate: Create one to choose where files are kept.
states.emptyDescription: No storage connection has been set up yet.
states.forbiddenDescription: You don't have permission to view this screen.
